name: SUNMED
recent: Sunway Healthcare 在2026年11月19日公布季度业绩，第三季净利按年增长59%至9520万令吉，营收7.374亿令吉。公司近期完成多项企业活动，包括以2.285亿令吉收购Sunway Medical Centre Velocity的A栋物业，以及与Putrajaya Holdings成立合资公司，在布城建设及租赁一所多专科私人医院。此外，雇员公积金局（EPF）在11月持续申报持股变动。
notable: 第三季净利按年增长59%至9520万令吉，营收7.374亿令吉。
以2.285亿令吉收购Sunway Medical Centre Velocity的A栋物业，交易已于2026年10月29日成为无条件。
与Putrajaya Holdings的子公司Tapak Senja成立合资公司，在布城建设及租赁一所多专科三级私人医院。
risks: 雇员公积金局（EPF）在11月多次申报持股变动。
首席财务官Cheng Chuan Shing于2026年10月15日行使20万股期权。
公司有多项关联方交易，包括向Sunway Integrated Properties收购物业及向Sunway REIT收购资产。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为6.729亿令吉，按季增长14.6%，按年增长29.8%；净利为7816万令吉，按季增长134.5%，按年增长88.9%；净利率为11.6%，高于上一季度的5.7%。

recent_en: Sunway Healthcare announced its quarterly results on 19 November 2026, with 3Q net profit up 59% year-on-year to RM95.2 million on revenue of RM737.4 million. The company recently completed several corporate exercises, including the RM228.5 million acquisition of Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity and a joint venture with Putrajaya Holdings to build and lease a multi-specialty private hospital in Putrajaya. EPF also continued to report changes in its shareholdings throughout November.
notable_en: 3Q net profit rose 59% year-on-year to RM95.2 million, with revenue of RM737.4 million.
Acquired Tower A of Sunway Medical Centre Velocity for RM228.5 million; the deal became unconditional on 29 October 2026.
Formed a joint venture with Tapak Senja, a subsidiary of Putrajaya Holdings, to build and lease a multi-specialty tertiary private hospital in Putrajaya.
risks_en: The Employees Provident Fund Board reported multiple changes in its shareholdings in November.
Chief Financial Officer Cheng Chuan Shing exercised 200,000 options on 15 October 2026.
The company has several related party transactions, including the acquisition of properties from Sunway Integrated Properties and assets from Sunway REIT.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM672.9 million, up 14.6% QoQ and 29.8% YoY; net income was RM78.2 million, up 134.5% QoQ and 88.9% YoY; net margin was 11.6%, compared with 5.7% in the previous quarter.
